news.title: OpenAI’s cozy partner Cerebras is on track for a blockbuster IPO
news.description: AI chip maker Cerebras is heading for a blockbuster IPO that could value it at $26.6 billion or more. It's relationship with OpenAI is deep and rich.

news.title: Image AI models now drive app growth, beating chatbot upgrades
news.description: Appfigures finds visual model launches generate 6.5x more downloads — but most don’t convert that spike into revenue.

news.title: Elon Musk’s only AI expert witness at the OpenAI trial fears an AGI arms race
news.description: Stuart Russell is a long-time AI researcher who thinks governments need to restrain frontier labs.

news.title: Sierra raises $950M as the race to own enterprise AI gets serious
news.description: The raise gives Sierra more than $1 billion to work with — capital the company says it will use to become the "global standard" for AI-powered customer experiences.

news.title: Elon Musk sent ominous texts to Greg Brockman, Sam Altman after asking for a settlement, OpenAI claims
news.description: Musk texted OpenAI's president and co-founder saying that he and CEO Sam Altman "will be the most hated men in America" if OpenAI doesn't settle the suit.

news.title: Oscars says AI actors and writing cannot win awards
news.description: The academy that controls the Oscars on Friday issued new award eligibility requirements around the use of artificial intelligence in film.

news.title: Pentagon says US military to be an 'AI-first' fighting force
news.description: The US military has agreed eight new contracts with big tech firms as it expands its artificial intelligence capabilities.

news.title: Spotify adds 'Verified' badges to distinguish human artists from AI
news.description: The music streaming platform will review criteria such as artists' live dates and social media presence.
